current_behavior.behavior: preloadExperts fills the global pool in descriptor order, without router information.
The active vector excludes empty expert_assignments for virtual experts. stage(active) and demand registration already contain only active experts and preserve ascending expert order.
queue_future requests every nonresident descriptor in each future layer; its router has not run yet. Every future resident descriptor is pinned.
take_batch calls nonselective prefetch end before stage(active), after this layer routing is already available.
prefetch end waits for all descriptors and registers all; no row_count mask.
Existing selective collection rejects non-decode batches. It already demonstrates safe unstarted cancellation and delayed slot recycling, but is not directly available to prefill.
DSP validates handles only when row_count>0 and builds order from active experts; zero-row expert weights do not participate in numerical work.

feasibility_after_router.reason: Existing fused prepared router publishes sel/weight to ARM; assignmentsFromRoute has already materialized exact per-expert vectors before take_batch. Prepared input cookie retains activation, not an obligation to use all64 handles.
feasibility_after_router.possible_extension: Pass exact active keys into a prefill-selective batch completion. Cancel only unstarted unused reads, skip unused registration, and keep running-reader ownership/reservations until completion. Leave active expert order, weights and prepared activation unchanged.
limits: Most reads may already be complete by router return; after-router selection cannot recover their IO traffic.
For an1/av1 only87/186 descriptor reads in aggregate were incomplete at layer collection. This is an upper bound on incomplete reads, not an unused or cancellable count; in-flight work is included.
Skipping all future reads until routing would remove overlap and can increase exposed stalls; NNTR_MOE_PREFETCH=0 is not an established speedup.
Global LRU hold/unhold and pending retire counts must change together; never return an in-flight slot to the pool.
Existing selective keep_ready defaults to retaining already-read guesses; simply calling it with active keys does not automatically avoid all unused registration.
Malformed unused weights currently may fail during speculative loading. Choosing not to read them changes when such file errors are observed and needs explicit contract review.
